item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00670","case1_error":"Concludes $20 after correctly deriving $12 per chair; the final number contradicts the completed calculation.","case2_error":"Misidentifies elapsed days and invents 6x = 12 + x instead of relating 12 remaining pills to six remaining days.","reason":"Case 1 substitutes an unsupported final number after correct calculations; case 2 constructs an erroneous relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00671","case1_error":"Uses 12 birds per snake instead of the stated 3, confusing rates at different feeding stages.","case2_error":"Subtracts the overlap twice, excluding germs killed by both sprays from the total killed.","reason":"Using the wrong feeding rate differs from double-subtracting an intersection when calculating a union.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00672","case1_error":"Multiplies miles directly by dollars per gallon, omitting conversion from miles to gallons.","case2_error":"Assumes $1 per coin and treats three sold coins as the initial count; the meaning of the $12 is unclear.","reason":"Case 1 clearly omits a unit conversion. Case 2 contains unsupported assumptions, but the question materially ambiguously describes the $12 after payment.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00673","case1_error":"Evaluates 18 months plus 6 years as 8.5 years instead of 7.5 years.","case2_error":"Omits the original $10,000 purchase from total expenditure, subtracting resale proceeds only from the second ring's cost.","reason":"Case 1 incorrectly evaluates a correctly specified duration; case 2 leaves a required expense out of the calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00674","case1_error":"Triples the original nine T-shirts instead of the three sweaters found when determining returned T-shirts.","case2_error":"Reports Yeon's 1,020 seeds instead of the requested combined total of 1,660 seeds.","reason":"Case 1 uses the wrong comparison base; case 2 answers an individual quantity instead of the requested aggregate.","judgment":"different"}]}
